newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa tests support in light trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa tests support in light trade.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa came under pressure in light trade on Friday, testing support levels as the pound firmed up and some traders liquidated long positions.
Active December fell 13 stg from Thursday's 1,043 to close at 1,030, its nearest support level.
Nearby September also tested support at 1,000 before closing 12 stg down at 1,002. The back months fell between seven and 10 stg.
"We are right at support areas. December has bounced off 1,030 on three occasions in the past week or so, so that is a good support area," a trader said.

Trading volumes were the lowest in several months in the morning session and prices fell back as Ivory Coast and many European markets closed for the Assumption Day holiday. Only 413 lots were traded in the morning.

Activity picked up a little after the break and traders said sterling's strengthening position against the dollar combined with continued long liquidation and a bit of weekend book squaring brought cocoa futures under further pressure.
There was also some trade selling.
Volume totalled 2,985 lots, with December accounting for 1,042 followed by September with 612.
